# 🛡️ SecureBank: Java UI + Java OOP + SQL

Savings & Current accounts modelled with **inheritance, polymorphism, custom exceptions** (Java 17),
stored in **SQL** (PostgreSQL on Render / H2 locally) through **JDBC**.

**The UI is Java too.** Every page is generated by Java code (`web/Views.java`, `web/Html.java`),
forms use POST + redirect, sessions live on the server, and there is **no JavaScript at all**
(the Content-Security-Policy header even blocks scripts). Only `style.css` is static.

## Run locally
If Maven is installed locally:
```bash
mvn clean package
java -jar target/securebank.jar            # web app  -> http://localhost:8080
java -jar target/securebank.jar console    # classic console menu (original brief)
```
If `mvn` is not on `PATH` (common on Windows), use the bundled build script instead:
```bat
build-jar.bat
java -jar target\securebank.jar            # web app -> http://localhost:8080
java -jar target\securebank.jar console    # classic console menu (original brief)
```
No database setup needed locally: it falls back to an embedded H2 file in `./data`.

Demo accounts (created on first start): `1001/1111`, `1002/2222` (Savings) · `2001/3333`, `2002/4444` (Current).
Admin key: `admin123` (env `ADMIN_KEY`).

## Deploy on Render
1. Push this folder to a GitHub repo.
2. Render dashboard → **New + → Blueprint** → select the repo (it reads `render.yaml`).
3. Render creates the PostgreSQL DB and the Docker web service and wires `DATABASE_URL` automatically.
4. First build takes ~4-6 min. Free tier sleeps after 15 min idle → first load ~30-50 s.

## Layers
| Layer | Code |
|---|---|
| UI (Java, server-side rendered) | `web/WebServer` (routes, sessions), `web/Views` (pages), `web/Html` (layout), `resources/web/style.css` |
| Business / OOP | `model/Account` (abstract), `SavingsAccount`, `CurrentAccount`, `exception/*`, `service/Bank`, `service/PolymorphismLab` |
| SQL | `db/Database` (pool + schema), `db/AccountDao` (JDBC), `db/Insights` (GROUP BY / JOIN) |
| Console | `console/ConsoleApp` |

## Routes
`GET /` dashboard · `GET /account` · `POST /login` · `POST /logout` · `GET|POST /open` ·
`POST /tx` (deposit / withdraw / transfer / interest) · `GET /lab` · `GET /admin` · `POST /admin/unlock` · `GET /api/health`
